split_rule.selection: random.Random(20261015).sample over sorted family IDs of each training topic, in topic order

notes: lean_statement is one sample instance; the builder varies it along instance_variation.
Reference proofs, step counts and the single-tactic screen come from the evaluation build stage, not from this file.
Families that the screen solves are removed from evaluation and labelled in training.

topics.name: Congruences and the Chinese remainder theorem

families.name: Divisor of a linear combination
families.informal: If c divides a and b, then c divides ma + nb.
families.lean_statement: (a b c m n : ℤ) (ha : c ∣ a) (hb : c ∣ b) : c ∣ m * a + n * b

families.name: Euclidean step
families.informal: gcd(a + kb, b) = gcd(a, b).
families.lean_statement: (a b k : ℕ) : Nat.gcd (a + k * b) b = Nat.gcd a b

families.name: Product of consecutive integers
families.informal: 2 divides n(n + 1).

families.name: Divisibility of n^k - n
families.informal: 6 divides n^3 - n.
families.instance_variation: exponent and divisor (n^2 - n by 2, n^5 - n by 30)

families.name: Common divisor of coprime numbers
families.informal: If d divides a and b and gcd(a, b) = 1, then d = 1.
families.lean_statement: (a b d : ℕ) (h1 : d ∣ a) (h2 : d ∣ b) (h3 : Nat.gcd a b = 1) : d = 1

families.name: Bezout coefficients exist
families.informal: There are x, y with ax + by = gcd(a, b).
families.lean_statement: (a b : ℤ) : ∃ x y : ℤ, a * x + b * y = (Int.gcd a b : ℤ)

families.name: Euclid's lemma
families.informal: If a is coprime to c and a divides bc, then a divides b.
families.lean_statement: (a b c : ℤ) (h : IsCoprime a c) (hd : a ∣ b * c) : a ∣ b

families.name: Unsolvable linear equation
families.informal: If gcd(a, b) does not divide c, then ax + by = c has no solution.
families.lean_statement: (a b c : ℤ) (h : ¬ ((Int.gcd a b : ℤ) ∣ c)) : ¬ ∃ x y : ℤ, a * x + b * y = c

families.name: Solve a linear equation
families.informal: Find integers x, y with 17x + 5y = 1.

families.name: Coprime from a combination
families.informal: If ax + by = 1, then a and b are coprime.
families.lean_statement: (a b x y : ℤ) (h : a * x + b * y = 1) : IsCoprime a b

families.name: Combine congruences
families.informal: From a ≡ b and c ≡ d (mod n), get ac + d ≡ bd + c (mod n).
families.lean_statement: (a b c d n : ℤ) (h1 : a ≡ b [ZMOD n]) (h2 : c ≡ d [ZMOD n]) : a * c + d ≡ b * d + c [ZMOD n]

families.name: Raise a congruence to a power
families.informal: If a ≡ b (mod n), then a^k ≡ b^k (mod n).
families.lean_statement: (a b n : ℤ) (k : ℕ) (h : a ≡ b [ZMOD n]) : a ^ k ≡ b ^ k [ZMOD n]

families.name: Solve a linear congruence
families.informal: Find x with 7x ≡ 3 (mod 11).

families.name: Chinese remainder theorem
families.informal: For all a, b there is x with x ≡ a (mod 3) and x ≡ b (mod 5).
families.lean_statement: (a b : ℕ) : ∃ x : ℕ, x ≡ a [MOD 3] ∧ x ≡ b [MOD 5]

families.name: Cancel a coprime factor
families.informal: If c is coprime to n and ca ≡ cb (mod n), then a ≡ b (mod n).
families.lean_statement: (a b c n : ℤ) (hc : IsCoprime c n) (h : c * a ≡ c * b [ZMOD n]) : a ≡ b [ZMOD n]

families.name: Fermat's little theorem
families.informal: In Z/p, a ≠ 0 gives a^(p-1) = 1.
families.lean_statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (a : ZMod p) (ha : a ≠ 0) : a ^ (p - 1) = 1

families.name: Euler's theorem
families.informal: If gcd(a, n) = 1, then a^φ(n) ≡ 1 (mod n).
families.lean_statement: (a n : ℕ) (h : Nat.Coprime a n) : a ^ Nat.totient n ≡ 1 [MOD n]

families.name: Wilson's theorem
families.lean_statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : ((p - 1).factorial : ZMod p) = -1

families.name: Last digit of a power family
families.informal: 3^(4n+1) ends in 3.

families.name: Order divides p - 1
families.informal: The order of a unit mod p divides p - 1.
families.lean_statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (a : (ZMod p)ˣ) : orderOf a ∣ p - 1

families.name: Order of a residue
families.informal: The order of 3 mod 7 is 6.
families.lean_statement: orderOf (3 : ZMod 7) = 6

families.name: Power at the gcd
families.informal: If a^m = 1 and a^n = 1, then a^gcd(m,n) = 1.
families.lean_statement: {G : Type*} [Monoid G] (a : G) (m n : ℕ) (hm : a ^ m = 1) (hn : a ^ n = 1) : a ^ Nat.gcd m n = 1

families.name: Primitive roots exist
families.informal: There is a unit mod p of order p - 1.
families.lean_statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : ∃ g : (ZMod p)ˣ, orderOf g = p - 1

families.name: Order divides any annihilating exponent
families.informal: If a^k = 1, then the order of a divides k.
families.lean_statement: (n : ℕ) (a : (ZMod n)ˣ) (k : ℕ) (h : a ^ k = 1) : orderOf a ∣ k

families.name: Euler's criterion, residue case
families.informal: If a is a nonzero square mod p, then a^(p/2) = 1.
families.lean_statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (a : ZMod p) (h : IsSquare a) (ha : a ≠ 0) : a ^ (p / 2) = 1

families.name: -1 is a square mod p ≡ 1 (mod 4)
families.informal: If p ≡ 1 (mod 4), then -1 is a square mod p.
families.lean_statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : p % 4 = 1) : IsSquare (-1 : ZMod p)

families.name: Squares mod 4
families.informal: A square is never 2 mod 4.

families.name: Legendre symbol is multiplicative
families.lean_statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (a b : ℤ) : legendreSym p (a * b) = legendreSym p a * legendreSym p b

families.name: Quadratic reciprocity, p ≡ 1 (mod 4)
families.informal: If p ≡ 1 (mod 4), q is an odd prime and q ≠ p, then q is a square mod p iff p is a square mod q.
families.lean_statement: (p q : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] [Fact q.Prime] (hp : p % 4 = 1) (hq : q ≠ 2) (hpq : p ≠ q) : IsSquare (q : ZMod p) ↔ IsSquare (p : ZMod q)

families.name: Totient of a prime
families.lean_statement: (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : Nat.totient p = p - 1

families.name: Totient of a prime power
families.lean_statement: (p k : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hk : 0 < k) : Nat.totient (p ^ k) = p ^ (k - 1) * (p - 1)

families.name: Sigma is multiplicative
families.informal: σ(mn) = σ(m)σ(n) for coprime m, n.
families.lean_statement: (m n : ℕ) (h : Nat.Coprime m n) : ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 (m * n) = ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 m * ArithmeticFunction.sigma 1 n

families.name: Gauss's totient sum
families.informal: The sum of φ(d) over divisors d of n is n.
families.lean_statement: (n : ℕ) : ∑ d in n.divisors, Nat.totient d = n

families.name: Möbius at a prime
families.lean_statement: (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) : ArithmeticFunction.moebius p = -1

families.name: Parity in Pythagorean triples
families.informal: If a^2 + b^2 = c^2, then a or b is even.

families.name: Obstruction mod 3
families.informal: x^2 - 3y^2 = 2 has no integer solution.

families.name: Three cubes mod 9
families.informal: x^3 + y^3 + z^3 is never 4 mod 9.

families.name: No solution for exponent 4
families.informal: a^4 + b^4 = c^4 has no solution with a, b nonzero.

families.name: Pell equation witness
families.informal: Find x, y > 0 with x^2 = 2y^2 + 1.
